+position_column: todo

+title: 'Add the MarketplaceStore core: layers, sync (fetch, snapshot, install), events, offline, seed'
+---
+## What
+
+marketplace.md §6.1, §6.2, §7.3, §7.5. The actor that joins the parts. Update checks, pins, and automatic update are a later task. This task makes `start()` bring every marketplace to its current head one time.
+
+Create `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/MarketplaceStore.swift`:
+- `public actor MarketplaceStore: MarketplaceLayerProviding`, `init(sources: [MarketplaceSource], cacheDirectory: URL = MarketplaceCache.cacheDirectory(environment: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment), policy: MarketplacePolicy = MarketplacePolicy())`, plus an internal init that takes a `GitTransport` (tests pass a counting double or the real `LibGit2Transport`). It rejects a list with a duplicate id (the sources task's `validate`).
+- The cache folder name uses the key that is known before a fetch (`alias`, else the last path component of the repository), through `cacheFolderName`. After a fetch, the catalog name becomes the display id in `MarketplaceProvenance`.
+- `nonisolated func marketplaceLayers() -> [MarketplaceLayer]`, in list order, with no network I/O. A git source gives `<cache>/<folder>/current`. A `file://` source gives `<folder>/<path ?? "skills">` directly, and a `select` other than `.all` gives a diagnostic. When the cache has no entry and `SKILLS_MARKETPLACE_SEED` names a folder with the same layout that has one, use the seed entry. A seed entry is never updated.
+- `func start() async` and `func update(_ id: String? = nil, force: Bool = false) async -> [MarketplaceEvent]`. The sync for one git source: `remoteHead` (or the pinned `sha`) → if it differs from `currentSha` (or `force`): `fetch` → `GitTreeFileSource` → `CatalogResolver` → `SnapshotWriter` into `snapshots/<sha>.tmp` → `MarketplaceCache.install` → `state.json` → `.updated` on `events` and a value on `layerUpdates`.
+- Any failure publishes `.failed(id:error:keptVersion:)` and keeps `current`. The registry is never built from a partial state.
+- `nonisolated var events: AsyncStream<MarketplaceEvent>` and `nonisolated var diagnostics: [MarketplaceDiagnostic]`.
+
+- [ ] Init, validation, and `marketplaceLayers()` (git, `file://`, seed)
+- [ ] The sync pipeline for one source
+- [ ] `start()` and `update(_:force:)` over all sources
+- [ ] `events`, `layerUpdates`, and the failure path that keeps the last good snapshot
+- [ ] Tests
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Cold start over a fixture repository: `marketplaceLayers()` is empty of skills at first; after `start()`, a `SkillsRegistry(marketplaces:stack:)` has the fixture skills, with one reload
+- [ ] A second `start()` with no remote change does no fetch
+- [ ] An unreachable URL publishes `.failed` with `keptVersion`, and the old skills stay
+- [ ] A `file://` source and a seed entry each give a layer with no network
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplaceStoreTests.swift` with `GitFixtureRepository` over `file://`, a temporary cache folder, and the real `LibGit2Transport`: cold start; no-change restart (a counting wrapper around the transport sees zero fetches); a new commit and `update()` swap `current`; an unreachable URL keeps the last good snapshot; a duplicate id is rejected; the `file://` source; the seed folder
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter MarketplaceStoreTests`; then `swift test`; all green and hermetic
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
